1479-5700-5701-6754-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6754-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

339-677-7272-7297.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-7272-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5670-7286.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4871-5670-7286.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, South Wind Avatar and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

512-2872-7287.easyPrerequisites: Transdimensional Bovine and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
512-2872-7287.description:
Activate Transdimensional Bovine by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Transdimensional Bovine, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

141-413-3085.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-413-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Zombify.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-6006-6112--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6006-6112--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2034-6970-7297-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3532-5078-6259-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4390-4668-5078-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
4390-4668-5078-6757-7633.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
4390-4668-5078-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

4068-4871-7072.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
4068-4871-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

3532-3836-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3836-5078-5402.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

2438-2781-2947.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Vesperlark.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3197-4017-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4017-6719.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

586-1796-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2060-2092-5140-6260.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2092-5140-6260.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

3017-3129-5742-5743.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

747-974-1636-3654-4868.notablePrerequisites:
Go-Shintai and Plaguemaw Beast do not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
747-974-1636-3654-4868.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
When Smaug enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Plaguemaw Beast by tapping it and sacrificing Smaug.
When Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Go-Shintai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning There and Back Again from your graveyard to the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's first chapter ability triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you.
Resolve the Plaguemaw Beast ability from step 4, putting two lore counters on There and Back Again.
There and Back Again's second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second There and Back Again trigger, causing you to search your library for a Mountain and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the third There and Back Again trigger, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Repeat from step 3.

132-198-549-824.notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-198-549-824.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {U} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Leech Bonder's ability by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a counter from a creature onto another creature.
Repeat.

339-2011-4278.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela and Jegantha do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
339-2011-4278.description:
Activate Bretagard Stronghold's second ability by paying {G}{W}{W}, tapping and sacrificing it, giving Jegantha vigilance until end of turn and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Move to your combat phase, and declare Najeela and Jegantha as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1558-1692-4840.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Myr Battlesphere.
1558-1692-4840.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere with haste.
The Myr Battlesphere token enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Myr Battlesphere token and sacrificing the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

802-2649-3147-3664.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
802-2649-3147-3664.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional non-Human creature that can be cast for {0}.
802-2649-3147-3664.description:
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning the additional creature to your hand and untapping Lotus Field and Azorius Chancery.
Activate Lotus Field and the land by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W/U}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast the additional creature by paying {0}.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R} plus commander tax if applicable, mutating it under the additional creature.
The mutated creature's ability from Vadrok triggers, casting Snap from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Snap, returning both cards that compose the mutated creature from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Lotus Field and Azorius Chancery.
Repeat from step 2.
